script: Uranus probably smells like rotten eggs. Its upper clouds contain hydrogen sulfide. That is the same gas that gives rotten eggs their stink. But you would not survive long enough to notice. Its air is mostly hydrogen and helium, at around minus 200 degrees Celsius. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
